name: San Marino National Data Center (project)
developer: IeS Informatica e Servizi (commissioned via AASS), with TIM San Marino technical support
notes: San Marino RTV (state broadcaster, 10 Jul 2026) reports the Congress of State commissioned a preliminary feasibility study, via AASS (state public-services utility), from IeS Informatica e Servizi with technical support from TIM San Marino, presented to stakeholders to size a national data center. Framed as strategic for digital sovereignty serving the public administration, banking sector and private businesses, and potentially neighbouring Italian regions; TIM San Marino cites a Tier 4 security target. Division/location not yet determined; no capacity figures published.

name: TIM San Marino Data Center (IDC)
developer: TIM San Marino S.p.A. (Telecom Italia San Marino)
notes: TIM San Marino offers professional housing/colocation (from a single server to full racks) at its own Data Center (IDC): redundant 10 Gb/s fibre uplinks to the Internet via two separate sites, direct peering at MIX Milan (NAP), >10 Gb/s Internet capacity, raised floor, HVAC, UPS, generators, fire suppression and 24x7 monitoring; the facility shares a building with a TIM network node. Registered office per RIPE: Via Ventotto Luglio 212, 47893 Borgo Maggiore (Centro Uffici Tavolucci); exact DC site not published - AS15433 IP geolocation points to Serravalle. No public MW capacity.

name: Data Center (Data Project) Falciano
developer: Data Project Servizi informatici / Data Center brand (est. 2022)
notes: Local cloud/IT provider born from Data Project Servizi informatici (2022) running data center and disaster-recovery infrastructure located exclusively within San Marino; offers VPS (Windows/Linux/RouterOS), VPN, PKI/smart-card, private/hybrid cloud, S3-compatible test environments and virtual offices. HQ: Strada Ca' Valentino 91, Falciano (Serravalle castello, Rovereta industrial zone). Small facility; no public MW capacity. Evidence from company LinkedIn page, company site and a partner directory.
